scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Medium Scale Ornamental Fish Rearing Unit (Fresh Water) - Haryana
description:
The Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana is a flagship scheme launched by the Government of India on September 29, 2020. 

This scheme aims to enhance fish production and promote sustainable fisheries in India. 

The initiative is part of the broader vision to achieve the goal of doubling the income of fishers and fish farmers. 

The scheme is particularly focused on developing the fisheries sector in a holistic manner. 

It seeks to create a framework for the sustainable development of the fisheries sector. 

The Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana includes various components. 

One of these components is the establishment of medium-scale ornamental fish rearing units. 

This specific component is designed to promote the rearing of freshwater ornamental fish. 

The initiative is particularly relevant for states like Haryana, which have a growing interest in aquaculture. 

The objectives of this scheme are multi-faceted. 

One of the primary goals is to increase fish production in India to 22 million metric tons by 2024-2025. 

The scheme also aims to create employment opportunities for around 15 million people in the fisheries sector. 

It is expected to enhance the income of fishers and fish farmers by 2024. 

The ornamental fish rearing unit aims to promote entrepreneurship among youth. 

This will help in generating additional income for families involved in fish farming. 

The scheme provides various benefits and assistance to eligible beneficiaries. 

Financial assistance of up to INR 20 lakh is available for setting up medium-scale ornamental fish rearing units. 

This financial support is provided as a subsidy to encourage investment in the sector. 

The subsidy can cover up to 40% of the total project cost for individuals. 

For Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes, the subsidy can go up to 60%. 

The assistance is also aimed at promoting the use of modern technology in fish rearing. 

The scheme encourages the establishment of hatcheries and nurseries for ornamental fish. 

This will help in ensuring a steady supply of quality fish for the market. 

Eligibility criteria for the scheme are clearly defined. 

Individuals or groups interested in setting up ornamental fish rearing units can apply. 

Applicants must be at least 18 years of age. 

There are no specific educational qualifications required for this scheme. 

However, a basic understanding of aquaculture practices is beneficial. 

The income criteria are not rigidly defined but preference is given to economically weaker sections. 

The application process for the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana is straightforward. 

Interested applicants must fill out the application form available on the official website. 

The application form requires details about the proposed project and the applicant's background. 

Documents required include identity proof, address proof, and a project report. 

The project report should outline the business plan and financial projections. 

Once the application is submitted, it will be reviewed by the concerned authorities. 

The review process typically takes around 30 days. 

If approved, the applicant will receive a sanction letter detailing the subsidy amount. 

Disbursement of funds is generally made in two installments. 

The first installment is released after the project is sanctioned. 

The second installment is released after the completion of the project and verification. 

The scheme is implemented by the Department of Fisheries under the Ministry of Fisheries Animal Husbandry and Dairying. 

State fisheries departments also play a crucial role in the implementation at the state level. 

In Haryana, the Department of Fisheries is responsible for overseeing the scheme. 

The contact details for the Haryana Department of Fisheries can be found on their official website. 

They provide assistance and guidance to applicants throughout the process. 

The scheme is expected to significantly boost the ornamental fish market in India. 

The global ornamental fish market is valued at approximately USD 15 billion. 

India has the potential to capture a significant share of this market. 

The initiative will also promote eco-friendly practices in fish farming. 

Sustainable practices are encouraged to minimize environmental impact. 

The scheme emphasizes the importance of training and capacity building. 

Workshops and training sessions are organized for beneficiaries. 

These sessions cover best practices in fish rearing and management. 

The ornamental fish rearing units are expected to create local employment opportunities. 

This will contribute to the overall economic development of rural areas. 

The scheme is aligned with the government's vision of Atmanirbhar Bharat. 

It aims to make India self-reliant in fish production. 

The Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana is a significant step towards achieving this goal. 

The ornamental fish rearing component is a unique opportunity for entrepreneurs. 

It opens avenues for innovation and diversification in the fisheries sector. 

The scheme also aims to promote the export of ornamental fish. 

This will help in earning foreign exchange for the country. 

The initiative is expected to attract investments in the fisheries sector. 

The government has set aside substantial funds for the successful implementation of the scheme. 

In the financial year 2021-2022, the government allocated INR 20,000 crore for the Matsya Sampada Yojana. 

This funding is aimed at various components of the scheme, including ornamental fish rearing. 

The scheme is a part of the larger National Fisheries Policy. 

This policy aims to promote sustainable fishing practices across the country. 

The Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana is a transformative initiative. 

It has the potential to revolutionize the fisheries sector in India. 

The focus on ornamental fish rearing is a strategic move. 

It caters to the growing demand for ornamental fish in domestic and international markets. 

The scheme is expected to create a robust ecosystem for fish farming in Haryana. 

This will ultimately contribute to the overall growth of the state's economy. 

The Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana is a comprehensive approach to fisheries development. 

It addresses various challenges faced by the sector. 

The emphasis on medium-scale units is particularly noteworthy. 

It allows for scalability and better resource management. 

The scheme is a significant opportunity for aspiring fish farmers in Haryana. 

It encourages them to take advantage of the growing ornamental fish market. 

The Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana is a vital step towards sustainable fisheries in India.
